title: Assess Long-term Feasibility of Reduced Dose Dasatinib in Chronic Phase Chronic Myeloid Leukemia Patients

sections.abstract: This study is conducted in patients with newly diagnosed CP CML (Chronic Phase Chronic Myeloid Leukemia) who have achieved EMR (\< 10% IS BCR-ABL) at 3 months after first line treatment with dasatinib. Subjects will be allocated to 80mg QD based on EMR (Early Molecular Response) achievement and early safety profile following a standard of care approach.
